# Endless Drawing

> One drawing. Everyone. Forever.

A shared infinite white canvas at https://endlessdrawing.com. Open the page and draw with everyone. No account. Общий бесконечный холст: рисуйте вместе, без регистрации.

The public page is the canvas itself. There is no separate landing page. Tools open on request. English by default; Russian when the browser prefers ru. The drawing is saved on the server and seen live by everyone on the same canvas.

The private administration area is not part of the public site and is excluded from the sitemap.
